Overview.Name: IMMADI Krupa
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1 (Light Meal): Option 1: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cucumber slices
Option 2: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Dinner Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable fry

Notes_and_Tips: Keep dinner structured and consistent as it is your main meal.
Start meals with eggs, chicken or paneer before eating rice.
Avoid skipping meals during stressful work shifts.
Get regular morning sunlight exposure to support thyroid balance, sleep and energy.
Simple meals with consistent timing will improve body composition and reduce cravings.
